name: Clique Salon & Med Spa
address: Middle of Outback Restaurant Plaza, 5315 Florida Ave S Unit 1, Lakeland, FL 33813, United States
hours: Friday (Black Friday), 9 AM to 6 PM, Hours might differ

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jess Rodriguez
reviewSamples.text: I can’t say enough amazing things about Rosa! As a Dominican woman with thick, curly hair, it has always been a challenge for me to find someone who truly knows how to cut and blow dry my hair the right way. Normally my hair takes forever to blow dry, but Rosa gets it done quickly while still giving me flawless results. I’ve been coming to her for over 3 years now, and she is hands down the BEST! Whether I want to wear my hair curly or straight, she makes it look fabulous every time. On top of her talent, Rosa is so flexible with her schedule and always willing to squeeze me in when I have an emergency. She’s not only skilled, but efficient, consistent, and always makes me feel beautiful when I leave her chair. Rosa is truly a gem, and I couldn’t imagine trusting anyone else with my hair!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ruth Hernandez
reviewSamples.text:
I can’t recommend Rosa enough! I’ve been going to her for over two years, and she has consistently exceeded my expectations. My hair is very long and thick, so it’s not easy to manage, but Rosa has the experience, patience, and talent to make it look absolutely beautiful every single time.

She truly listens to what I want and always delivers. Thanks to her, my hair has remained healthy, soft, and gorgeous. And I have to mention her hair washes—they are the BEST! They’re so relaxing that I’ve actually fallen asleep in her chair more than once. 😊

Finding someone you trust with your hair is priceless, and I wouldn’t go anywhere else. If you’re looking for someone who genuinely cares about your hair and takes pride in her work, Rosa is the one. I highly recommend her!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Kimberly Bowser
reviewSamples.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Exceptional Experience with Rosa at Clique Salon

I recently had the pleasure of having my hair done by Rosa at Clique Salon, and I couldn't be more thrilled with the results! From the moment I sat in her chair, she took the time to listen to my concerns and preferences, ensuring she understood exactly what I wanted. Rosa's expertise and attention to detail were evident as she worked her magic, transforming my hair into a style that exceeded my expectations.

The salon itself is modern and welcoming, with a clean and comfortable atmosphere that made the entire experience enjoyable. Rosa's professionalism and friendly demeanor made me feel at ease throughout the process.

If you're looking for a talented stylist who truly cares about delivering top-notch results, I highly recommend booking an appointment with Rosa at Clique Salon. I'm already looking forward to my next visit!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Natasha Dagher
reviewSamples.text: Rosa is the hair whisperer. She fixed my hair strands and made my hair look so healthy! I recommend her and I am sure the other ladies are amazing as well. So happy to found someone that can finally work with me thick, wavy hair. She explains everything she does and why and will never go against what you want but recommend what is best. Thank you Rosa!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Kristina Lynn
reviewSamples.text:
My daughter and I received services here and we are extremely happy with the service we received.  Brandi and Kate was amazing at turning our hair into exactly what we had envisioned.
I received my first botox session, targeting my tmj, and Jimmy was amazing! He explained everything throughly and answered every question I had.
We will definitely be going back and recommending everyone here!
